name: DriveMosaic
soft_passes: #1 ships pre-masked (alpha corners + baked darker squircle rim) rather than a square unmasked bleed layer; system re-masks fine but the rounded container is a delivered artefact
#4 16px squint: five large blocks survive as a colourful tile grid, but the tiny cells smear to noise and the precise treemap reading is lost
#7 figure-ground: tiles-vs-field contrast strong, tile-vs-tile weak and merges to near-uniform gray in grayscale
failures: #3 silhouette: solid-black = featureless rounded square, zero contour identity; the mark reads only via internal tessellation + colour
#6 palette economy: 12+ competing hues with no reserved accent (violates the <=2-hue rule) — purposeful, since the polychrome is a category legend, but a failure by the letter
#10 variant robustness: tint/mono collapses all 12 hues to one and the whole colour-coded concept dies; cannot participate in macOS 26 tinted mode
light_model: Per-cell top-down linear gradient — every tile lighter at top, ~20L darker at bottom (e.g. #689CC5->#5282AA), consistent direction across all cells; no specular, no cast shadow. Decorative per-cell shading rather than a global scene light.
layer_stack: dark navy field #1A1B25 with a baked darker squircle rim
gradient-shaded treemap tile mosaic (12 rounded-rect cells, ~8px dark gutters) floating on the field
devices: the product as its own portrait (icon is a stylized render of the app's core treemap view)
muted-rainbow treemap used as a semantic category legend, desaturated vs the cover's saturated version
per-cell top-down gradient giving soft embossed depth without glass/gloss/bevel
dark grout field with even ~8px gutters reading as a tiled mosaic wall
rhymes_hint: data-viz emblem family — utility icons that render their own output as the mark (disk analysers, monitors, stats tools); muted mid-century colour-block palette; dark-field flat-geometric utility icons
notes: 1024x1024 RGBA, crisp native render (clean 1px tile edges, no JPEG/resize blur) — resolution trustworthy. Delivered PRE-MASKED: alpha=0 corners + a baked darker rim at the squircle edge, so it's a finished masked icon, not the square unmasked layer Apple's HIG asks for (note #1). Field is blue-biased near-black #1A1B25, not pure black. Era call: matte/soft/front-facing/uniform-squircle reads Big Sur, but carries NO Liquid Glass layering (no specular/refraction/translucency), so on macOS 26 it renders as a legacy flat icon and cannot be tinted (see #10) — arguably 'custom' since the whole-canvas data-viz composition isn't the era's stock tool-on-field convention. Palette coherence with cover: SAME rainbow-treemap concept but icon is muted/dusty while the marketing cover uses saturated/vivid hues (#7c5cff purple, hot pink, teal) — deliberate quieting for the mark. Borderline on the HIG 'don't replicate UI components' guidance: the icon is close to a stylized screenshot of the app's own view, abstracted just enough (no chrome/labels) to read as an emblem. All three rubric fails share one root: the full-canvas polychrome pattern maximizes hero-size recognizability at the cost of silhouette, economy, and tint-survival.
